source: measured: the token-gated reference (solution/) on the 32 fixed hidden states with this grader in the verifier image (CPU rendering, 4 CPUs, 12 GB): job_balanced_recovered_fraction 1.0 (32 of 32 states) in each of 2 standalone grading runs (2026-11-11, identical step counts per state) and in the ale validate oracle; during selection every kept state's replay recovered in 3 of 3 runs and in 2 of 2 runs with 1e-9 restore noise (160 of 160 replays)
note: full_at 1.0: the oracle is an exact replay and shows no spread on this host; clause C6 keeps only states whose replay survives a 1e-9 perturbation of the restored joint positions, and the grader fails as a task error (never a silent oracle loss) if a host's replayed prefix differs from the recording by more than 1e-9.
